facts.description: The statutory background permits leases up to 30 years and requires prior Central Government approval for a term exceeding 30 years.
The Port may lease land up to a maximum cumulative period of 30 years with Board approval.
Renewals beyond 30 years, up to a 99-year cumulative limit, require Board recommendation and the Empowered Committee/Government path.
Capital-intensive proposals beyond 30 years are submitted with Board recommendations through the Empowered Committee and Ministry approval path.
The later clarification treats renewal as a fresh lease and determines authority from the renewal period without counting the earlier lease.
The PGLM compilation contains the corresponding clarification text.
